column1: # Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# One row per capability that has been given a CEF Q4 determination:
#   capability_id  originating issue number (e.g. 206) or a stable capability id
#   requirement    'required'  -> must resolve to valid evidence (gate blocks if not)
#                  'not-required' -> a deliberate CEF decision that graded
#   suite          evaluation suite under evaluations/ (e.g. orchestration)
#   topology       recorded evidence to validate (suite's runs/<topology>/)
# States: an ABSENT entry is undeclared (advisory during initial adoption);
# a 'not-required' entry is a deliberate determination; a 'required' entry must
# resolve to valid evidence. See docs/reference/evaluation.md and ADR-0026.
# NOTE: the orchestration suite is RESEARCH EVIDENCE, not a shipped capability,
# so it is intentionally NOT indexed here.
